dct_title_s: Scene of the present terrible conflict in front of Richmond. Positions formerly held by our right wing-Mechanicsville, White House, Meadows Bridge, Gaines' House, Dispatch and Tunstall's Station's-The Pamunkey River still commanded by our gunboats-Fort Darling menaced by the Union fleet-James River our present base of operations, and forming our means of communication for supplies
